issues.decision: Replace the broad 1997-2004 ball-joint safety card with recall 04V-596's exact 2000-2003 4x4 population, moisture/corrosion mechanism, separation risk, and both-upper-joints remedy.

evidence.label: DaimlerChrysler Recall 04V-596 - Dakota Upper Ball Joints

trims: Four-wheel-drive vehicles built through December 31, 2002 and included in recall 04V-596; verify by VIN
after.title: Upper Ball-Joint Corrosion Can Lead to Wheel Separation (Recall 04V-596)
after.description: NHTSA recall 04V-596 covers certain 2000-2003 four-wheel-drive Dodge Dakota pickups. Water can enter a front upper ball joint, remove lubricant, and corrode the joint. Extended wear can allow the joint—and potentially the front wheel—to separate, causing loss of control.
after.solution: Check the VIN for recall 04V-596. DaimlerChrysler's campaign remedy is replacement of both front upper ball joints. A clunk may occur as wear progresses, but the recall warns that occupants may not always hear it.
symptoms: Upper ball joint may wear excessively
Front wheel may separate if the joint fails

issues.decision: Replace the 1992-1999 forum aggregation with official DaimlerChrysler TSB 09-05-00's exact 1994-1999 engine scope, oil-consumption/spark-knock symptoms, confirmation procedure, and plenum-gasket replacement.

evidence.label: DaimlerChrysler TSB 09-05-00 - Spark Knock and Oil Consumption

trims: Vehicles equipped with a 3.9L, 5.2L, or 5.9L gasoline engine
after.title: Spark Knock or Oil Consumption From an Intake Plenum-Pan Gasket Leak
after.description: DaimlerChrysler TSB 09-05-00 applies to 1994-1999 Dodge Dakota vehicles with 3.9L, 5.2L, or 5.9L gasoline engines. An internal intake-manifold plenum-pan gasket leak can cause engine oil consumption or spark knock without an external oil leak.
after.solution: Follow the bulletin's diagnostic procedure to confirm an internal plenum vacuum leak and complete the prerequisite PCM calibration check in TSB 18-48-98. If the gasket leak is confirmed, replace the intake-manifold plenum-pan gasket using the specified cleaning, torque, and tightening sequence.
symptoms: Increased engine oil consumption without an external leak
Internal vacuum leak at the intake plenum pan

issues.decision: Retain the exact 2000 4.7L automatic-transmission fill-tube fire recall with a direct NHTSA campaign link and only the official vent-hose/clearance remedy.

evidence.label: NHTSA Recall 00V-197 - Dakota Transmission Fluid Expulsion

trims: Vehicles with the 4.7L engine and automatic transmission included in recall 00V-197; verify by VIN
after.title: Transmission Can Expel Fluid Onto the Hot Exhaust (Recall 00V-197)
after.description: NHTSA recall 00V-197/890 covers certain 2000 Dodge Dakota pickups with the 4.7L engine and automatic transmission. During normal-temperature operation, transmission fluid may be expelled from the fill tube and can ignite if it contacts the hot exhaust system.
after.solution: Check the VIN for recall 00V-197/890. The recall remedy is to shorten the transmission vent hose and confirm adequate clearance. Do not substitute a transmission rebuild or generic leak repair for the recall procedure.
symptoms: Automatic-transmission fluid expelled from the fill tube
Transmission fluid may contact the hot exhaust

citations.title: NHTSA Recall 00V-197 - Dakota Transmission Fluid Expulsion
